archive_china_official_gold_tonnes.basis: Converted reported ten-thousand troy ounces using 31.1034768 grams per fine troy ounce.

archive_china_official_gold_usd_bn.label: China reported monetary gold market value
archive_china_official_gold_usd_bn.basis: SAFE values in USD 100 million divided by 10. Value varies with price and holdings.

archive_china_fx_reserves_usd_bn.label: China foreign currency reserves
archive_china_fx_reserves_usd_bn.basis: Foreign currency reserve line excluding monetary gold. SAFE values in USD 100 million divided by 10.

archive_china_gold_share_official_reserv.label: China gold share of official reserve assets
archive_china_gold_share_official_reserv.basis: Reported monetary gold value divided by total reported official reserve assets.

archive_china_real_gdp_growth_annual_pct.label: China annual real GDP growth
archive_china_real_gdp_growth_annual_pct.basis: Annual World Bank value stored in December of its observation year.

archive_china_cpi_inflation_annual_pct.label: China annual CPI inflation
archive_china_cpi_inflation_annual_pct.basis: Annual World Bank value stored in December of its observation year.

archive_china_mine_gold_usgs_annual_tonn.label: China gold mine production, USGS MCS
archive_china_mine_gold_usgs_annual_tonn.basis: USGS MCS 2025 for 2023 and MCS 2026 for 2024–25, with 2025 estimated. December observation label.

archive_world_official_gold_purchases_ec.label: Global central-bank net gold purchases, ECB annual
archive_world_official_gold_purchases_ec.basis: ECB 2026 Chart 6, Q1 plus rest-of-year. A net flow. Full calendar years only.

archive_world_mine_gold_wgc_quarter_tonn.label: Mine production, World Gold Council
archive_world_mine_gold_wgc_quarter_tonn.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_world_mine_gold_wgc_annual_tonne.label: Mine production, World Gold Council
archive_world_mine_gold_wgc_annual_tonne.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_world_recycled_gold_wgc_quarter_.label: Recycled gold, World Gold Council
archive_world_recycled_gold_wgc_quarter_.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_world_recycled_gold_wgc_annual_t.label: Recycled gold, World Gold Council
archive_world_recycled_gold_wgc_annual_t.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_world_gold_supply_wgc_quarter_to.label: Total supply, World Gold Council
archive_world_gold_supply_wgc_quarter_to.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_world_gold_supply_wgc_annual_ton.label: Total supply, World Gold Council
archive_world_gold_supply_wgc_annual_ton.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_world_official_gold_net_demand_w.label: Central banks and other institutions, World Gold Council
archive_world_official_gold_net_demand_w.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_world_official_gold_net_demand_w.label: Central banks and other institutions, World Gold Council
archive_world_official_gold_net_demand_w.basis: Public Gold Demand Trends table. Most recent edition providing the observation is used. Annual totals and quarterly values can come from different vintages.

archive_gold_sgd_oz_monthly_avg_est.label: Gold in SGD estimated from monthly averages
archive_gold_sgd_oz_monthly_avg_est.basis: World Bank gold monthly average × monthly-average SGD per USD.

archive_gold_cny_oz_monthly_avg_est.label: Gold in CNY estimated from monthly averages
archive_gold_cny_oz_monthly_avg_est.basis: World Bank gold monthly average × monthly-average CNY per USD. The result is a currency conversion and excludes the Shanghai premium.

archive_gold_to_silver_ratio.label: Gold/silver ratio
archive_gold_to_silver_ratio.basis: World Bank gold average divided by silver average in the same month.

archive_gold_real_usd_oz_oct2026.label: Gold in October 2026 U.S. dollars
archive_gold_real_usd_oz_oct2026.basis: World Bank nominal monthly gold × October 2026 CPI / observation-month CPI.

archive_gold_usd_mom_pct.label: Gold monthly change
archive_gold_usd_mom_pct.basis: Percent change in World Bank monthly averages.

archive_gold_usd_yoy_pct.label: Gold 12-month change
archive_gold_usd_yoy_pct.basis: Percent change in World Bank monthly averages vs. same month one year earlier.

archive_gold_usd_drawdown_pct.label: Gold drawdown from prior monthly high
archive_gold_usd_drawdown_pct.basis: World Bank monthly average / running maximum monthly average since January 1960 minus one.

archive_gold_real_usd_yoy_pct.label: Inflation-adjusted gold 12-month change
archive_gold_real_usd_yoy_pct.basis: Percent change in CPI-deflated gold vs. same month one year earlier.

archive_us_cpi_yoy_pct.label: U.S. CPI 12-month inflation
archive_us_cpi_yoy_pct.basis: Current seasonally adjusted CPI / CPI 12 months earlier minus one.

archive_us_pce_yoy_pct.label: U.S. PCE 12-month inflation
archive_us_pce_yoy_pct.basis: Current PCE price index / index 12 months earlier minus one.

archive_china_cpi_yoy_pct.label: China CPI 12-month inflation, OECD series
archive_china_cpi_yoy_pct.basis: Current OECD China CPI / CPI 12 months earlier minus one.

archive_us_10y_real_yield_mom_bps.label: Change in 10-year real yield
archive_us_10y_real_yield_mom_bps.basis: Current minus prior month’s mean TIPS yield, multiplied by 100.

archive_us_10y_2y_curve_bps.label: U.S. Treasury 10-year minus 2-year spread
archive_us_10y_2y_curve_bps.basis: Difference of monthly-average Treasury yields, multiplied by 100.

archive_usd_broad_mom_pct.label: Broad dollar month-on-month move
archive_usd_broad_mom_pct.basis: Percent change in monthly averages of the current Fed broad dollar series.

archive_cny_per_usd_mom_pct.label: USD/CNY month-on-month move
archive_cny_per_usd_mom_pct.basis: Percent change in CNY per USD monthly averages. Positive means CNY weaker versus USD.

archive_spx_price_mom_pct.label: S&P 500 monthly price return
archive_spx_price_mom_pct.basis: Last available close this month / last close previous month minus one. Excludes dividends. Blank for incomplete months.

archive_spx_price_monthly_avg_mom_pct.label: S&P 500 change in monthly average
archive_spx_price_monthly_avg_mom_pct.basis: Change in monthly-average index closes. Used against gold monthly-average changes for matched return timing.

archive_gld_price_mom_pct.label: GLD ETF monthly price return
archive_gld_price_mom_pct.basis: Last available GLD close / previous month’s close minus one. Blank for incomplete months.

archive_china_gold_holdings_mom_tonnes.label: Monthly change in China reported holdings
archive_china_gold_holdings_mom_tonnes.basis: Difference from previous observed calendar month. Blank across missing months. Zero means reported holdings were unchanged.

archive_gold_spx_corr_36m.label: Gold and S&P 500 return, rolling 36-month Pearson correlation
archive_gold_spx_corr_36m.basis: 36 consecutive complete monthly observations based on changes in the World Bank gold monthly average and the Hub SPX monthly average.

archive_gold_real_yield_corr_36m.label: Gold return and real yield change, rolling 36-month Pearson correlation
archive_gold_real_yield_corr_36m.basis: 36 consecutive monthly gold average changes versus monthly-average TIPS yield changes in bp.

archive_gold_usd_broad_corr_36m.label: Gold and broad dollar return, rolling 36-month Pearson correlation
archive_gold_usd_broad_corr_36m.basis: 36 consecutive monthly changes in gold and current Fed broad dollar averages.

USGS_WORLD_GOLD.label: World gold mine production · USGS
USGS_WORLD_GOLD.basis: Data Series 140 through 2022, then separate USGS MCS editions. 2025 is an estimate.
